context: A teen tells her mother about her day in Shibuya
purpose: Teach: 渋谷/北京/ハワイ/マレーシア/男子/まち/付近/ファッション

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ママただいま！今日ね、渋谷駅で友達と待ち合わせしてきたんだ。
lines.en: Mom, I'm home! Today I met up with my friends at Shibuya Station.
lines.style: Cheerful teen greeting, casual and upbeat tone with rising energy

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おかえり、さくら。渋谷の付近って人多かったでしょう？
lines.en: Welcome back, Sakura. The area around Shibuya was crowded, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm motherly tone, gentle curiosity with soft falling intonation

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、まちの中心はもう人だらけ！でも楽しかったよ。
lines.en: Yeah, the center of town was packed with people! But it was fun.
lines.style: Animated teen speech, slightly breathless, casual exaggeration

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 新しいファッションのお店がいっぱいできてて、見てるだけで楽しいの。
lines.en: Lots of new fashion shops have opened, and just looking around was fun.
lines.style: Excited girlish chatter, fast-paced with shopping enthusiasm

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あらいいわね。お小遣いで何か買ったの？
lines.en: Oh, how nice. Did you buy something with your allowance?
lines.style: Indulgent maternal tone, mildly teasing, soft warmth

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うーん、今日は我慢した。でもね、ミカの彼氏が北京から留学してきた男子で、すごくかっこよかった！
lines.en: Hmm, I held back today. But Mika's boyfriend, a guy who came from Beijing as an exchange student, was super cool!
lines.style: Gossipy teen excitement, voice rising on the juicy detail

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: へえ、留学生なのね。さくらも将来ハワイやマレーシアみたいな所に行ってみたい？
lines.en: Oh, an exchange student. Would you also like to go somewhere like Hawaii or Malaysia someday?
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently encouraging, light wistful curiosity

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 行きたい！ハワイの海で泳いで、マレーシアでおいしいもの食べたいなあ。
lines.en: I want to go! I'd love to swim in Hawaii's ocean and eat delicious food in Malaysia.
lines.style: Dreamy teen voice trailing off, wistful and hopeful

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: じゃあ勉強も頑張らないとね。ご飯できてるから手を洗ってきなさい。
lines.en: Well then, you'd better study hard too. Dinner's ready, so go wash your hands.
lines.style: Practical mom redirecting affectionately, warm authority
